channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Salman Khan's thirst-trap gym photos go viral; flaunts biceps, thigh muscles [PICS]
item.description: Ahead of his 60th birthday, Salman Khan treated his fans to gym photos, looking fit and dapper in a black vest and blue shorts. He flexed his massive arms and strong legs for the camera and sported a clean-shaven look.

item.title: Bangladesh burns: Another student leader faces murderous attack
item.description: The victim was identified as Muhammad Motaleb Shikder, a student leader of the National Citizen Party (NCP), the same party to which Osman Haidi belonged. He was shot in the head in Khulna by unidentified gunmen this morning at around 11.45 AM. He is currently in the hospital undergoing treatment.

item.title: India in advanced stages of trade talks with US: Piyush Goyal
item.description: Goyal told journalists that India has already finalised free trade agreements with three members of the Five Eyes (FVEY) intelligence alliance — Australia, the UK, and New Zealand. The US and Canada comprise the other two members of the grouping.

item.title: Bengaluru RWA's moral policing gone wrong; members ousted, sued by 22-year-old woman
item.description: A Bengaluru woman has alleged harassment and unauthorised entry by apartment association members, triggering legal action and disciplinary steps within the housing society.

item.title: From Bearish Bets to Bullish Flows: What $352M In ETF Inflows Say About Crypto Sentiment
item.description: Wall Street has embraced Bitcoin; when we first traded it on our balance sheet, there were no ETFs—now BlackRock's Bitcoin ETFs are incredibly successful.

item.title: Indian stock market opens lower, IT stocks lead losses
item.description: As of 9.30 am, the Sensex declined 159 points, or 0.19 per cent to 85,407 and the Nifty lost 32 points, or 0.13 per cent to 26,139. Main broad cap indices showed divergent trends, with the Nifty Midcap 100 down 0.18 per cent, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 added 0.07 per cent.

item.title: Australia's Christmas period colored by grief, sadness following Bondi attack: PM Albanese
item.description: Albanese said at a press conference in Canberra that the fatal shooting of 15 people that targeted a Jewish festival at Sydney's Bondi Beach on December 14 was an antisemitic attack on the Jewish community as well as an attack on "Australian values and on Australian society."

item.title: India proud to stand by Sri Lanka during Cyclone Ditwah: EAM Jaishankar
item.description: In a post on X on Tuesday, the EAM Jaishankar said, "Looking forward to calling on His Excellency President Anura Kumara Dissanayake this morning. India is proud to have stood by Sri Lanka during Cyclone Ditwah and of its support through Operation Sagar Bandhu."

item.title: Newly-wed Samantha Ruth Prabhu mobbed, trips during Hyderabad event; Chinmayi says team suffered bruises
item.description: Several videos showed Samantha struggling to move amid the overwhelming crowd. As the crowd closed in on her, Samantha's security personnel were seen holding her hand and creating a path to escort her safely to her car. Despite the situation, Samantha remained composed and did not make any public comment as she made her way through the chaos.

item.title: 'Ruined OG song': Kartik Aaryan, Ananya Panday's Saat Samundar Paar 2.0 leaves netizens angry
item.description: Karan Johar-backed romantic comedy has landed in a copyright dispute over the 1992 hit Saat Samundar Paar. Trimurti Films, which owns the song's rights, has moved the Bombay High Court, alleging unauthorised use of its tune and lyrics. Trimurti Films is seeking Rs 10 crore in damages and an immediate ban on the song's use, a move that could affect promotions and even the release.
